title: hushrun.guide/v1
description: Output of `hushrun guide --format json` (spec C-28, ADR 0065): what a coding agent needs to know about this hushrun beyond its skill, and what is true here: a newer release the notice learned of, and each copy of the skill. It asks nobody, changes nothing, and exits 0. Fields are only ever added.

skillRevision.description: This hushrun's revision of the skill, which its SKILL.md says as metadata.hushrun-skill (C-24).

guide.description: The guide, in Markdown: what this hushrun's lines mean, how to set it up, and how it and its skill are kept current.

update.description: A newer release than this hushrun, as the newer-release notice last learned of it (C-21), with no question asked now; null when none is known, or with HUSHRUN_NO_UPDATE_CHECK set.

command.description: What updates this hushrun: `hushrun update`, or the package manager's install where one installed it, such as `npm install hushrun@latest`.

skills.description: Each copy of the skill hushrun looks at: the repository's, when it runs in one, then the person's own, under ~.

path.description: Relative to the repository's root, or ~/… for the person's own.

state.description: current: this hushrun's revision. older: an older hushrun wrote it, and `hushrun skill update` updates it. newer: a newer hushrun wrote it, and this hushrun is the one to update. edited: no hushrun wrote this text, and hushrun leaves it. absent: there is none.

revision.description: The revision it says, for current, older and newer: 0 for a text a hushrun wrote before revisions.
